contexts.text: When the Lord became Jehovah as to the Human also, that which was not life in itself, that is, which was merely human, was banished. This is signified by the son of the handmaid not being able to inherit with the son Isaac.
They who are of the Spiritual Church are signified by Hagar's son, after he had been banished.
These (thoughts) cannot make a man unclean, because they are banished...
If these truths... are banished from the midst further away to the sides...
The things received in thought, and not in will, are separated and banished.
If they reject (the doctrinal things of charity and faith) they are banished to their like...
